name: Windows Server Administration and Active Directory
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 and AZ-801, both retired on 30 September 2026)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) for hybrid work

beginner.summary: For system administrators and support engineers who are starting with Windows Server and Active Directory. Covers editions and roles, a Hyper-V lab with Server Core and Windows Admin Center, installation, PowerShell, Active Directory concepts, domain controllers and DNS, users, groups and OUs, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services and permissions, storage, Hyper-V, remote access with SMB over QUIC, updates and hotpatching, backup and the AD Recycle Bin, security baselines with Windows LAPS, monitoring and troubleshooting logons and name resolution. Written for Windows Server 2025.
prerequisites: Uses Windows as a power user
Understands IP addressing, DNS names and subnets
outcomes: Install and manage Windows Server with PowerShell and Windows Admin Center
Build a domain with users, groups, OUs, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP
Run file services, storage, Hyper-V and remote access securely
Patch, back up, monitor and troubleshoot servers and domains

days.topic: Windows Server Overview: Editions, Roles and the Course Network
subtopics: Windows Server 2025 editions: Standard, Datacenter and Azure Edition
Licensing by cores and client access licences
The servicing model and support dates
Windows Server compared with Linux servers
Certification paths after AZ-800 and AZ-801
Course project overview: a company with a head office and a branch
days.lab_task: Compare editions for the course company, list the roles each server will run and draw the course network with domain controllers, file servers and a Hyper-V host.
checks: Editions are chosen with licensing reasons
The network diagram shows all servers and subnets
objectives: Describe Windows Server editions and roles

days.topic: Lab Setup: Hyper-V Lab, Server Core and Windows Admin Center
subtopics: Enabling Hyper-V on a lab host
Installing Server Core and Desktop Experience VMs
days.lab_task: Build three lab VMs, two Server Core and one with Desktop Experience, configure them with sconfig, add them to Windows Admin Center and take a clean checkpoint.
checks: All three VMs run with their planned names and addresses
Windows Admin Center connects to every server
A clean checkpoint exists for each VM

days.topic: Server Installation and First Configuration
subtopics: Network settings and NIC teaming with Switch Embedded Teaming
days.lab_task: Configure networking, time, firewall rules and remote management on a new server, add the File Server role and record the build steps.
days.deliverable: Configured server with a build record
checks: Network, time and firewall settings are correct
The build steps can be repeated by a peer

days.topic: PowerShell for Windows Server Administrators
days.lab_task: Write PowerShell that reports disk space and services on all lab servers through remoting, exports a CSV and runs as a scheduled task.
checks: The script collects data from all servers
The scheduled task runs the script

days.topic: Active Directory Concepts: Forests, Domains, Sites and Domain Controllers
subtopics: Domain controllers and the global catalog
days.lab_task: Design the forest, domain, OUs and sites for the course company and explain how a user logs on from the branch.
days.deliverable: Domain design with a logon walkthrough
checks: Forest, domain, OUs and sites are defined
The branch logon steps are correct

days.topic: Installing Domain Controllers and DNS
subtopics: Preparing a server to be a domain controller
days.lab_task: Create the course forest on Server Core with PowerShell, add a second domain controller and a read-only DC at the branch, and check health with dcdiag.
days.deliverable: Healthy forest with three domain controllers
checks: The forest and DNS zones exist
dcdiag passes on all domain controllers

days.topic: Users, Groups and Organisational Units
subtopics: Group scopes: domain local, global and universal
days.lab_task: Create OUs, users and groups for three departments from a CSV with PowerShell, delegate password resets to the help desk and disable a leaver.
checks: Users and groups match the CSV
The help desk can reset passwords only in its OUs

days.topic: Group Policy: Objects, Links, Inheritance and Filtering
subtopics: Linking to sites, domains and OUs
Reporting with Resultant Set of Policy
days.lab_task: Create GPOs for password rules, a desktop setting and a drive mapping, link them to the right OUs, filter one by group and check results with gpresult.
checks: Settings reach the intended users and computers
The filtered GPO applies only to its group

days.topic: DNS Administration: Zones, Records and Forwarders
subtopics: A, CNAME, MX and SRV records
DNS for Active Directory locator records
days.lab_task: Create a reverse zone, add records, set a conditional forwarder for a partner domain, turn on scavenging and fix a seeded missing SRV record.
days.deliverable: DNS configuration with a fixed problem
checks: Partner names resolve through the conditional forwarder
Domain controllers are found after the SRV fix

days.topic: DHCP: Scopes, Reservations and Failover
days.lab_task: Create scopes for two subnets with options and reservations, configure DHCP failover between two servers and test a client lease during a failover.
checks: Clients get correct addresses and options
The reserved device always gets its address
Clients still get leases when one server is down

days.topic: File Services: Shares, NTFS Permissions and Access-Based Enumeration
subtopics: File Server Resource Manager quotas and screens
days.lab_task: Create department shares with group-based NTFS permissions, turn on access-based enumeration, set a quota and restore a file from a shadow copy.
checks: Users reach only their department's data
Users do not see folders they cannot open
A deleted file is restored from a shadow copy

days.topic: Storage: Disks, Volumes, Storage Spaces and ReFS
days.lab_task: Build a storage pool with mirrored and parity spaces, format volumes with ReFS and NTFS, enable deduplication and remove a disk to test resiliency.
days.deliverable: Storage spaces with a resiliency test
checks: The pool and spaces are healthy
Data stays available after a disk is removed

days.topic: Hyper-V: Virtual Machines, Switches and Checkpoints
days.lab_task: Create VMs with dynamic memory on an internal and an external switch, take and apply checkpoints and export a VM to another host.
days.deliverable: Managed VMs with checkpoint and export records
checks: VMs run on the right switches
Applying a checkpoint restores the earlier state
The exported VM runs on the second host

days.topic: Remote Access: SMB over QUIC, VPN and Remote Desktop Security
subtopics: SMB over QUIC for file access without VPN
Remote Desktop and Network Level Authentication
days.lab_task: Publish a file share with SMB over QUIC, set up a VPN for administrators and restrict Remote Desktop to the gateway with NLA.
checks: Remote users reach the share over QUIC
Direct Remote Desktop from outside is refused

days.topic: Windows Update and Hotpatching: WSUS, Update Rings and Azure Arc
subtopics: Hotpatching for Windows Server 2025 through Azure Arc
Baseline months that still need a restart
days.lab_task: Put lab servers into update rings, approve updates for a test ring, enrol one server in hotpatching through Azure Arc and report patch status.
days.deliverable: Update plan with a patch status report
checks: Servers are grouped into update rings
The enrolled server installs a hotpatch without a restart
Patch status is reported for all servers

days.topic: Backup and Recovery: Windows Server Backup and the AD Recycle Bin
subtopics: System state backups of domain controllers
days.lab_task: Back up a domain controller's system state, enable the Recycle Bin, delete an OU by mistake and restore it, then restore a file server volume.
checks: System state backups run on schedule
The deleted OU and its users come back
The file server volume is restored
objectives: Back up servers and domain controllers

days.topic: Security Baselines: Windows LAPS, Credential Guard and SMB Signing
subtopics: Windows LAPS for local administrator passwords
Disabling old protocols such as SMB1 and NTLMv1
days.lab_task: Apply a security baseline with Group Policy, deploy Windows LAPS, require SMB signing, disable SMB1 and check compliance.
days.deliverable: Hardened servers with a compliance report
checks: Local admin passwords are unique and stored in AD

days.topic: Monitoring: Event Logs, Performance Monitor and Windows Admin Center
subtopics: Performance Monitor and data collector sets
days.lab_task: Forward security events from all servers to a collector, build a data collector set for a busy server and alert on failed logons.
checks: Events from all servers reach the collector
Performance data shows the busy period
Repeated failed logons raise an alert

days.topic: Troubleshooting Logons, Group Policy and Name Resolution
subtopics: Useful tools: dcdiag, repadmin, nltest and gpresult
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, a locked account, a GPO not applying, a DNS failure and clock skew, fix them and record the steps.
checks: Logons, policies and lookups work after each fix

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Domain for a Small Company
subtopics: Users, groups, OUs and Group Policy
days.lab_task: Deliver a domain for the course company with two domain controllers, DNS, DHCP failover, users and groups from a CSV, Group Policy, department shares, a Hyper-V host, update rings, backups and a security baseline.
days.deliverable: Working small-company domain with a demo
checks: Users log on, get policies and reach their shares
A deleted user and a file are restored
The baseline and LAPS are in place

intermediate.summary: For Windows administrators and infrastructure engineers who run Windows Server and Active Directory for many users. Covers Active Directory design and delegation, sites and replication, FSMO roles and the Windows Server 2025 AD changes, advanced Group Policy, delegated and group managed service accounts, Active Directory Certificate Services, failover clustering, Storage Spaces Direct, Hyper-V at scale, DFS and Storage Replica, DNS security, DHCP and IPAM, hybrid identity with Entra Connect and Cloud Sync, Azure Arc, Azure File Sync, tiered administration, Remote Desktop Services, PowerShell DSC and JEA, migration to Windows Server 2025 and certification paths.
prerequisites: Runs a Windows domain with Group Policy, DNS and DHCP
Has used Hyper-V or another hypervisor
outcomes: Design Active Directory, replication, Group Policy and PKI for a mid-size company
Build clustered, highly available Hyper-V, storage and file services
Connect Windows Server to Entra ID and Azure with Arc and File Sync
Secure, automate and migrate Windows infrastructure

days.topic: Active Directory Design: Forests, Domains, OUs and Delegation
subtopics: OU design for administration and policy
days.lab_task: Redesign the course OU structure for delegation and policy, create role groups and delegate three administrative tasks with least privilege.
checks: OUs separate administration and policy needs
Each task is delegated to a role group
Delegated admins cannot act outside their OUs

days.topic: Sites, Replication and Domain Controller Placement
days.lab_task: Create sites for three locations with site links, place domain controllers, force replication and fix a seeded replication failure.
checks: Subnets map to the right sites

days.topic: FSMO Roles, Functional Levels and Windows Server 2025 AD Changes
subtopics: The 32K database page size optional feature
days.lab_task: Move FSMO roles between domain controllers, seize one in a simulated failure, and plan the raise to the Windows Server 2025 functional level with prerequisites.
days.deliverable: FSMO operations and a functional level plan
checks: The seized role works after the failure
Prerequisites for the raise are listed

days.topic: Advanced Group Policy: Preferences, WMI Filters, Loopback and the Central Store
days.lab_task: Use preferences with item-level targeting, a WMI filter for laptops, loopback for kiosk servers, a central store and GPO backup and restore.
checks: Preferences apply only to targeted items
Kiosk users get the kiosk settings
A changed GPO is restored from backup

days.topic: Managed Service Accounts: gMSAs and Delegated Managed Service Accounts
subtopics: Delegated managed service accounts in Windows Server 2025
Migrating from legacy service accounts to dMSAs
Why dMSA permissions need careful review
Using managed accounts for services and tasks
days.lab_task: Move a service to a gMSA, migrate a legacy service account to a dMSA, review who can create or change dMSAs and audit the remaining password accounts.
days.deliverable: Managed service accounts with a permissions review
checks: The service runs under the gMSA
The legacy account is replaced by a dMSA
Rights to create or change dMSAs are limited

days.topic: Active Directory Certificate Services: PKI Design and Auto-Enrollment
days.lab_task: Build a two-tier PKI with an offline root, publish templates for computers and web servers, auto-enroll computers and revoke a certificate.
checks: Root and issuing CAs are trusted

days.topic: Failover Clustering: Validation, Quorum and Cluster-Aware Updating
days.lab_task: Validate and build a two-node cluster with a cloud witness, cluster a file server role, patch it with Cluster-Aware Updating and fail a node.
checks: Cluster-Aware Updating patches both nodes without downtime
The role moves when a node fails

days.topic: Storage Spaces Direct and Hyperconverged Windows Server
days.lab_task: Build a lab Storage Spaces Direct cluster, create a mirrored CSV, run VMs on it and replace a failed drive.
checks: The failed drive is replaced and the pool repairs

days.topic: Hyper-V at Scale: Live Migration, Replica and GPU Partitioning
days.lab_task: Live migrate running VMs, replicate a VM to a second site with Hyper-V Replica, fail over and back, and assign a GPU partition to a VM.
checks: The VM uses its GPU partition

days.topic: File Server High Availability: DFS Namespaces, DFS Replication and Storage Replica
days.lab_task: Build a DFS namespace with replicated folders across two sites, add Storage Replica for a volume and recover from a seeded replication conflict.
checks: Users reach the nearest copy through the namespace
The conflict is resolved without data loss

days.topic: Network Services at Scale: DNS Security, DHCP and IPAM
days.lab_task: Sign an internal zone with DNSSEC, add a DNS policy for split responses, manage address space with IPAM and audit DHCP changes.
checks: The DNS policy returns site-specific answers
IPAM shows address use and changes

days.topic: Hybrid Identity: Entra Connect, Cloud Sync and Seamless SSO
subtopics: Password hash sync and pass-through authentication
days.lab_task: Sync two OUs to Entra ID with Cloud Sync, enable password hash sync and seamless SSO, and fix a seeded sync error.
days.deliverable: Hybrid identity with sync health evidence
checks: Users from the chosen OUs appear in Entra ID

days.topic: Azure Arc for Windows Server: Management, Policy and Hotpatching
subtopics: What Azure Arc adds to on-premises servers
days.lab_task: Onboard lab servers to Azure Arc, assign a machine configuration policy, patch through Update Manager and estimate monthly cost.
days.deliverable: Arc-managed servers with policy and patching

days.topic: Azure File Sync and Hybrid File Services
subtopics: Azure File Sync and its agents
Migrating file servers with File Sync
days.lab_task: Sync a file server to Azure Files with cloud tiering, add a second server at the branch and rebuild a failed server from the cloud copy.
days.deliverable: Hybrid file service with recovery test
checks: Files sync between servers and Azure
Cold files are tiered to the cloud
The failed server is rebuilt from the cloud

days.topic: Windows Server Security: Tiered Administration, Protected Users and Authentication Policies
subtopics: The enterprise access model and tiers
days.lab_task: Separate admin accounts by tier, add admins to Protected Users, build an authentication silo for domain admins and audit changes to privileged groups.
checks: Domain admins can log on only to tier 0 systems

days.topic: Remote Desktop Services: Session Hosts, Gateways and Licensing
subtopics: Comparing RDS with Azure Virtual Desktop
days.lab_task: Deploy an RDS collection with two session hosts, publish a RemoteApp through RD Gateway with FSLogix profiles and test load balancing.
checks: Users launch the RemoteApp through the gateway
User settings follow users across hosts

days.topic: Automation with PowerShell: DSC, Remoting and Just Enough Administration
subtopics: Machine configuration as the cloud successor to DSC
days.lab_task: Configure servers with a DSC configuration, give the help desk a JEA endpoint for service restarts only and test a script with Pester.
checks: The JEA endpoint allows only service restarts

days.topic: Migrating to Windows Server 2025: In-Place Upgrades, Storage Migration Service and AD Upgrades
subtopics: Storage Migration Service for file servers
days.lab_task: Upgrade a member server in place, migrate a file server with Storage Migration Service and replace a domain controller with a Windows Server 2025 one.
checks: The upgraded server runs its roles
Shares and permissions move to the new file server
The new domain controller replicates and the old one is demoted

days.topic: Windows Server Certification Paths after the AZ-800 and AZ-801 Retirement
subtopics: The retired AZ-800 and AZ-801 exams
What the Windows Server Hybrid Administrator skills covered
Current Microsoft certifications that cover hybrid work
Building evidence of skills without an exam
Mapping course days to job tasks
days.lab_task: Map course skills to the old AZ-800 and AZ-801 objectives and to a current certification, build a portfolio of three lab tasks and write a study plan.
days.deliverable: Skills map, portfolio and study plan
checks: Skills are mapped to old and current objectives
The portfolio holds three documented lab tasks
The study plan has a target certification

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Highly Available Windows Infrastructure for a Mid-Size Company
days.lab_task: Deliver infrastructure for a mid-size company with an AD design, sites, PKI, a Hyper-V cluster, DFS file services, hybrid identity, Arc management, tiered administration and automated configuration.
checks: AD, sites and PKI follow the design
Clustered services survive a node failure

advanced.summary: For infrastructure architects and senior Windows engineers. Covers enterprise AD architecture and consolidation, AD attack paths and hardening, tier 0 protection, forest recovery, ransomware resilience, PKI architecture, Azure Local and software-defined datacentre designs, large Hyper-V clusters, storage architecture, identity modernisation to Entra ID, Group Policy to Intune migration, regulated environments, monitoring with Defender for Servers, patch and lifecycle management, automation at scale, data centre exits, performance engineering, the operating model and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Runs Active Directory and Windows Server for a large organisation
Understands clustering, PKI and hybrid identity
Responsible for infrastructure design, security or operations
outcomes: Design and secure enterprise Active Directory, PKI and tier 0
Plan forest recovery and ransomware resilience
Design Hyper-V, storage and Azure Local platforms and move workloads to the cloud
Lead lifecycle, automation, operations and troubleshooting at scale

days.topic: Enterprise Active Directory Architecture and Forest Consolidation
days.lab_task: Plan the consolidation of three forests into one, migrate a pilot group of users and computers with SID history and plan removal of the old trusts.
checks: The consolidation has phases and rollback
Pilot users keep access after migration
Trust and SID history removal is planned

days.topic: Active Directory Attack Paths and Hardening: Kerberoasting, Delegation and ADCS Abuse
subtopics: Common attack paths in Active Directory
days.lab_task: Map attack paths in an authorised lab with BloodHound, demonstrate an ADCS template abuse, fix the template and delegation issues and confirm the paths are closed.
days.deliverable: Attack path report and hardening record
checks: Paths to domain admin are listed
The template abuse works before the fix

days.topic: Tier 0 Protection: Privileged Access Workstations and the Enterprise Access Model
subtopics: Why the red forest approach was retired
Protecting domain controllers and identity servers
days.lab_task: Define the tier 0 asset list, build a privileged access workstation, restrict tier 0 logons to it and monitor tier 0 changes.
checks: Tier 0 admins log on only from the workstation

days.topic: Active Directory Forest Recovery Planning and Testing
days.lab_task: Recover the lab forest in an isolated network from backup following a written runbook, measure the time taken and update the runbook.
checks: The first domain controller is restored
Recovery time is measured against the target

days.topic: Ransomware Resilience for Windows Infrastructure
days.lab_task: Protect backups with immutability, run a ransomware exercise in the lab, recover priority systems in the right order and record lessons.
checks: Backups cannot be deleted from the domain
Priority systems are restored in order

days.topic: PKI Architecture and Certificate Lifecycle at Scale
days.lab_task: Design PKI for a large estate with an HSM-protected issuing CA, govern templates, automate renewal monitoring and recover the issuing CA from backup.
checks: The hierarchy and HSM use are defined
The issuing CA is recovered from backup

days.topic: Azure Local and Software-Defined Datacentre Designs
subtopics: Azure Local, formerly Azure Stack HCI
Choosing between Windows Server clusters and Azure Local
days.lab_task: Design an Azure Local cluster for two branch data centres, size it, compare it with Windows Server clusters and recommend one.
checks: Compute, storage and networking are sized
Azure Local and Windows Server clusters are compared

days.topic: Hyper-V Clusters for Large Estates: Design, Capacity and Upgrades
days.lab_task: Size Hyper-V clusters for five hundred VMs, set anti-affinity for critical pairs and run a rolling upgrade of a lab cluster.
checks: Capacity covers the VMs with headroom
Critical pairs never share a host
The rolling upgrade completes without downtime

days.topic: Storage Architecture: Storage Spaces Direct, Storage Replica and Stretched Clusters
days.lab_task: Design storage for three workload types, build a stretched cluster with Storage Replica in the lab and fail over between sites.
checks: Each workload gets the right tier
The stretched cluster replicates between sites

days.topic: Identity Modernisation: Moving Workloads from AD to Entra ID
subtopics: Entra Domain Services and Kerberos to cloud apps
days.lab_task: Inventory AD dependencies, move two applications to Entra ID authentication and plan the next steps to reduce the AD footprint.
checks: Two apps sign in with Entra ID
The roadmap reduces AD step by step

days.topic: Group Policy to Intune and Cloud Policy Migration
subtopics: Server policies that stay in Group Policy
days.lab_task: Analyse client GPOs with Group Policy analytics, move twenty settings to Intune, test them on a pilot ring and retire the old GPOs.
checks: Settings are classified by cloud support
Pilot devices get settings from Intune
Old GPOs are unlinked and archived

days.topic: Windows Server in Regulated Environments: Baselines, Audit and Evidence
days.lab_task: Apply a CIS baseline, design audit policy, collect evidence for an audit request and remediate two seeded findings.

days.topic: Monitoring at Scale: Azure Monitor, Defender for Servers and Event Forwarding
days.lab_task: Monitor the estate with Azure Monitor and event forwarding, turn on Defender for Servers, build a workbook and route alerts to the operations team.
checks: Logs and metrics arrive from all servers
Defender raises alerts on seeded threats

days.topic: Patch and Lifecycle Management at Scale: Hotpatching, Maintenance Windows and End of Support
days.lab_task: Build a patch strategy with hotpatching and maintenance windows, report servers near end of support and plan their replacement.
checks: Windows and rings cover every service
Servers near end of support are listed
Replacement plans have dates and owners

days.topic: Automation at Scale: Desired State, Infrastructure as Code and Pipelines for Windows
subtopics: Machine configuration and DSC at scale
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that creates a hardened server image, applies configuration as code and detects drift on deployed servers.
checks: The image is built and hardened by the pipeline

days.topic: Large Migrations: Data Centre Exit, Server Consolidation and Cloud Moves
subtopics: Moving workloads to Azure or other clouds
days.lab_task: Assess two hundred seeded servers, decide rehost, replatform or retire for each, plan migration waves and rehearse one cutover.
days.deliverable: Migration assessment, wave plan and rehearsal

days.topic: Performance Engineering for Windows Server and Hyper-V
subtopics: CPU, memory, disk and network counters
days.lab_task: Diagnose a seeded slow application server with performance counters and a trace, fix the bottleneck and show the improvement.

days.topic: Windows Server Operating Model: Roles, Change and Service Levels
days.lab_task: Design the operating model for Windows services with roles, a service catalogue, change rules and on-call, and report a seeded month of service metrics.
checks: Changes and incidents follow the process
objectives: Run Windows infrastructure as a service

days.topic: Troubleshooting at Scale: Replication Failures, Kerberos and Cluster Outages
days.lab_task: Diagnose seeded problems at scale, a replication failure with lingering objects, a duplicate SPN and a cluster outage, fix them and write an incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, fixes and an incident review
checks: Each problem's cause is shown with evidence
Replication, Kerberos and the cluster work after the fixes
objectives: Write a post-incident review with the root cause and a preventive action

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Windows Infrastructure Modernisation Plan
days.lab_task: Present a modernisation plan for the Windows estate to a review board with the AD architecture, tier 0 and hardening, forest recovery and ransomware tests, platform choices, identity modernisation, lifecycle plan and operating model.
days.deliverable: Modernisation plan with evidence and a board decision
checks: Recovery and resilience claims have test evidence
Modernisation and lifecycle plans have owners
